collection.description: One serial, single-process run of the JSON assessment profile over every location entry in a 2026-09-13 retrieval of https://chihealth.com/cms-hpt.txt, under the default retrieval policy: identified User-Agent with a contact address, HTTPS only, robots.txt fetched and obeyed in code before every request, one shared per-host minimum interval held across the whole run rather than reset per invocation, conditional revalidation against the verified cache, retry backoff, and the default 1 GiB decoded-size ceiling. The retrieval policy fingerprint is byte-identical to the one the 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-12 cohorts were collected under. No URL was replayed from an earlier run: every graded URL is the one this origin's own cms-hpt.txt published on the day of the run.

population.basis: Every location this document lists was targeted, so this run is a complete enumeration of one origin's publication set rather than a draw from a frame. The origin was selected on cost -- it is the cheapest origin in the committed discovery registry with at least ten locations in an implemented profile -- so with respect to the 3,024-hospital sampling frame at data/frames/2026-08-19.frame.json this run is a convenience selection and estimates nothing about it. It deliberately records no sampling_frame, and the published statistics block therefore refuses with no_sampling_frame rather than computing a share of a population it did not sample. These rows are kept out of data/cohorts/ for the same reason: folding an origin-scoped enumeration into the seeded probability samples published there would change what those cohorts' Wilson-score estimates are estimates of.

https://www.chihealth.com/content/dam/ch: CHI Health Richard Young Behavioral Health
CHI Health Creighton University Medical Center - Bergan  Mercy
CHI Health Creighton University Medical Center - University Campus

discovery.method: `mrf-honest discover` retrieved https://chihealth.com/cms-hpt.txt on 2026-09-13 with an identified client; the attempt and its parse are durable evidence in the local discovery registry. No MRF URL in this run was hand-assembled and none was carried over from an earlier cohort.

policy: A cohort manifest attests the collection context that assessment rows cannot carry by themselves (docs/PHASE-3-FINDINGS.md). `build_comparison` refuses to compare rows without the operator_controlled_single_run attestation.

statistics.basis: the disposition of every facility in this cohort's probability stratum: each published row of that stratum, and each recorded exclusion, as a share of the sample the frame recorded. Shares describe the drawn sample; they are not weighted by bed count, discharge volume, or spend, and they are never pooled across strata or across cohorts.

refusal.reason: the cohort manifest records no sampling frame, so there is no population for a proportion to describe
